issues.description: Class Bitmap24: the methods Bitmap24::save(const std::string &i_filename) and Bitmap24::set(int i_y, int i_x, char i_r, char i_g, char i_b) are declared private in the template header, but are invoked as public methods in the template example program (main.cpp). The solution repository's Bitmap24.hpp declares these methods as public. This visibility mismatch causes the example program in the template to fail to compile and confuses students because the header hides methods that the provided example and the reference solution expect to be public.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template repository's example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp, move the declarations of save(const std::string &i_filename) and set(int i_y, int i_x, char i_r, char i_g, char i_b) from the private: section into the public: section (i.e. make them public). This aligns the template header with the solution header and allows example_program/src/main.cpp to compile and run as intended.
